RemainingQuestions: the dossier neither enumerates its gaps nor implies completeness — it simply contains nothing, so it cannot claim knowledge it lacks, but it also never says what it does not know; this is not clear-cut, hence 'uncertain'. ConversationReadiness: with no substantive content and only an uncited-content pointer to a 2024 Senate testimony document, a reader could not prepare talking points, positions, or biographical context beyond the bare anchors.
